title: Magento PolyShell unauthenticated file upload now in CISA KEV; mass exploitation continues
why: Not ahead: CISA added CVE-2026-48356 to KEV on Oct 27 (due Nov 10).
action: Apply APSB26-73, deny all access to pub/media/custom_options/, then audit the cms_block table, admin users and the filesystem for loaders, webshells and GSocket backdoors.
product: Adobe Commerce / Magento Open Source 2.4.9, 2.4.8-p5, 2.4.7-p10, 2.4.6-p15, 2.4.5-p17, 2.4.4-p18 and earlier (fixed by 2026-jul isolated patch, APSB26-73)

title: Oracle E-Business Suite unauthenticated SQLi-to-RCE (TCF servlet): exploit attempts seen in the wild days after the October CPU
why: Defused Cyber's EBS decoys recorded exploratory exploit attempts on Oct 27 (reported by BleepingComputer, The Hacker News and SecurityWeek). Public GitHub PoC/lab repos appeared on Oct 27, and Horizon3 has published the attack chain. It is not in CISA KEV: the KEV feed had no new entries this run. Oracle has not tagged it as exploited. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Apply the October 2026 CPU (MOS Note KA923) to every EBS 12.2.3-12.2.15 instance. Until then, remove /OA_HTML/AppsTCFServer from the EBS URL firewall allowlist, then hunt for unauthenticated POSTs to that path and for the oracle account spawning /bin/sh.
product: Oracle E-Business Suite 12.2.3 through 12.2.15 (Application Object Library, Core; /OA_HTML/AppsTCFServer)

title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect auth bypass: SOCRadar 'Operation Master' intrusion and data-theft pipeline uses it
action: Confirm GlobalProtect is patched, then hunt for AdaptixC2 and unexpected portal sessions on previously exposed gateways.
product: PAN-OS GlobalProtect (affected versions per PAN advisory)

title: Volt Typhoon 'Silent Train' covert relay network: four confirmed zero-day campaigns on SD-WAN and management platforms (Lumen Black Lotus Labs)
why: Not ahead: all named CVEs are already in CISA KEV (VeloCloud CVE-2026-16812 since Jul 27), and Microsoft named and tracks Volt Typhoon. The Quest KACE zero-day is only a moderate-confidence suspicion with no CVE (activity faded after Quest's Oct 2025 updates).
action: Confirm Versa Director, N-central, Catalyst SD-WAN, VeloCloud Orchestrator and KACE are on fixed releases with admin interfaces off the internet, then review their admin activity and keep long-retention central logs.
vendor: Multiple (Versa, N-able, Cisco, Arista VeloCloud, Quest)
product: Versa Director, N-able N-central, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem, Quest KACE SMA

title: SonicWall SMA1000 pre-auth SSRF (CVSS 10.0): honeypot exploitation attempts since Oct 8, still not in CISA KEV
why: Previdian and Defused Cyber honeypots have recorded exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-102255 since Oct 8, reported by THN, SecurityWeek and BleepingComputer. It was not in CISA KEV as of catalog 2026.10.21 (Safeguard check), and the KEV additions on Oct 23 and Oct 26 did not include it. SonicWall's advisory still says there is no evidence of exploitation, and no successful compromise has been publicly confirmed. Rechecked Oct 28: the Oct 27 KEV additions (PolyShell, Brotli) do not include it.
action: Upgrade every SMA1000 to 12.4.3-03670 or 12.5.0-03082 or later, restrict Work Place exposure, and review appliance logs since Oct 6 for requests to internal services.
product: SonicWall SMA1000 6210/7210/8200v, 12.4.3-03526 and older, 12.5.0-02952 and older (includes the September fix builds)

title: Fragnesia Linux kernel LPE (ESP-in-TCP page-cache write, Dirty Frag variant) added to CISA KEV after use in PHP2Shell firewall intrusions
why: Not ahead: CISA added it to KEV on Oct 28 (due Oct 31).
action: Install distro kernels with the shared-frag fix. Until then, set user.max_user_namespaces=0 where you can, and triage internet-facing PHP hosts for root webshells before rebooting.
product: Linux kernel (XFRM ESP-in-TCP; fix commit f84eca581739 'preserve shared-frag marker during coalescing')

title: NGINX heap overflows/UAF (CVSS4 9.2) allow unauthenticated DoS and possible RCE in specific configurations
why: F5 advisory K000163408 and an oss-security disclosure. No in-the-wild use, no public PoC, not in CISA KEV. Not re-searched this run.
action: Upgrade NGINX to 1.30.6/1.31.7 (or F5 fixed builds) and review configs with nginx -T for alias/map/aio usage.
product: NGINX Open Source before 1.30.6 / 1.31.7; NGINX Plus 37.0.0-37.0.4; Ingress Controller, Gateway Fabric, Instance Manager

title: EDK II PXE driver pre-boot RCE (CVSS4 9.5): Microsoft Project Mu ships fix, still no EDK II stable release or OEM firmware
why: TianoCore advisory GHSA-99cj-7hg9-mp4m, with Ars Technica, The Hacker News (Oct 28) and an oss-security thread (Oct 28). Microsoft's Project Mu fork has pulled the fix and tagged builds on Oct 26. Upstream EDK II still has no stable release with the fix, and the advisory reads 'Not patched currently'. No MSRC advisory, not in CISA KEV, no PoC or in-the-wild use reported.
action: Disable PXE/UEFI network stack where not needed, keep PXE on isolated provisioning VLANs, and track OEM firmware and distro edk2/OVMF updates for CVE-2026-97631.
vendor: TianoCore (EDK II); downstream AMI, Insyde, Phoenix, Project Mu, OVMF
product: EDK II NetworkPkg UefiPxeBcDxe up to edk2-stable202608 (fix merged Oct 15, PR 13302); vendor firmware updates pending

title: VMware ESX command-logging bypass used as a zero-day by WARP PANDA (CrowdStrike) now in CISA KEV
why: Not ahead: added to CISA KEV Oct 28 (due Nov 11).
action: Patch ESX to the VMSA-2026-0006 builds, forward ESXi logs off-host, and investigate vCenter/ESXi environments that were unpatched before late July for WARP PANDA activity.
product: VMware ESX 8.0 before ESXi80U3j-25429389, 9.0 before 9.0.2.0100-25595025, 9.1 before 9.1.0.0-25370933 (VCF, vSphere Foundation, Telco Cloud Platform)

title: Apache Traffic Server: unauthenticated ImageMagick argument injection in experimental magick plugin (CVSS 10) among 15 ATS fixes
why: Apache's Oct 21 advisory discloses an unauthenticated CVSS 10.0 flaw. No PoC or in-the-wild use, not in CISA KEV. Not re-searched this run.
action: Upgrade ATS to 9.2.16/10.1.5/10.2.1 and disable the magick, tsmemcache and wasm experimental plugins if not needed.

title: FortiSandbox GUI unauthenticated auth bypass to command execution (CVSS 9.6, vendor E:F)
why: Fortinet FG-IR-26-185 and ZDI-26-771 describe the flaw, and Fortinet's vector carries E:F, but no public exploit has been found. Not in CISA KEV.
action: Upgrade FortiSandbox to 5.0.7 or 4.4.10 and restrict the management GUI to admin networks.

title: Tailworm: Tailscale 1.104.4 fixes SSH socket-forwarding root escalation and three more flaws (TS-2026-014 to 017), no CVEs
why: The researcher (Cyberdione Labs) published full details on Oct 25. Tailscale shipped 1.104.4 with bulletins TS-2026-014 to 017 on Oct 27. There are no CVE IDs, no in-the-wild reports, and it is not in KEV. The headscale findings remain unfixed. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade all Tailscale nodes to 1.104.4. Where you cannot, set TS_SSH_DISABLE_FORWARDING=1. On headscale, treat every SSH grant as root on the target.
product: Tailscale client before 1.104.4 (Tailscale SSH with forwarding, Serve); headscale up to 0.29.6 control-server findings not fixed by the client release

title: Supermicro BMC IPMI: unsigned, unencrypted commands accepted on live sessions (CVSS 9.8 CNA), plus 7 more BMC CVEs
why: Supermicro published advisories on Oct 26 and runZero (HD Moore) published research the same day. NVD published the CVEs on Oct 27. None of the nine CVEs was in CISA KEV at Rescana's check on Oct 27. No public PoC and no in-the-wild use reported.
action: Apply the BMC firmware Supermicro lists for each board, and keep IPMI (UDP 623) reachable only from an isolated management network.
product: Supermicro BMC firmware on select X12/X13 and other pre-X14 motherboards (X14 affected by CVE-2026-65213); fixed BMC firmware listed per board, two boards still TBD

title: WatchGuard Fireware OS: unauthenticated SIP-proxy RCE, FireCluster admin-action and Access Portal heap overflow among 18 Firebox fixes
why: WatchGuard published 18 Fireware OS advisories on Oct 27, seven of them CVSS 9.1 or higher, including an unauthenticated SIP-proxy stack overflow (CVE-2026-93857). WatchGuard says it knows of no exploitation and there is no public PoC (SecurityOnline, VulDB). None of the CVEs is in CISA KEV, even though earlier WatchGuard flaws are. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade Fireboxes to Fireware OS 2026.4, 12.12.4 or 12.5.22. Until then, disable the SIP proxy and Access Portal where unused, isolate FireCluster links and restrict management interfaces.
product: Fireware OS before 2026.4 / 12.12.4 / 12.5.22 (Firebox appliances)

title: jackson-databind polymorphic-typing validator bypass via generic type arguments (CVSS 9.8), incomplete fix for CVE-2026-54512
why: The NVD record (Oct 28) and the GHSA advisory describe a working bypass: a gadget class wrapped in a generic type argument gets past the validator, with demonstrated Spring FileSystemXmlApplicationContext command execution. Not in CISA KEV and no in-the-wild reports. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade jackson-databind to 2.18.12, 2.21.8, 2.22.4, 3.1.8 or 3.2.4, and find any use of activateDefaultTyping or @JsonTypeInfo(use=CLASS) on untrusted input.

title: MLflow unauthenticated RCE via third-party scorer deserialization importing caller-placed artifact modules (CVSS 9.8)
why: The GitHub advisory GHSA-26p8-2jq9-3vq9 (Oct 27) describes RCE on unauthenticated MLflow servers. No PoC or in-the-wild use has been reported and it is not in CISA KEV. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade MLflow to 3.17.0 or later and put tracking servers behind authentication; never expose them to untrusted networks.
product: mlflow 3.12.0rc0 up to before 3.17.0

title: Brazilian Magecart group compromises Convertr's shared Plausible analytics script, skimming cards on all Convertr checkouts since Oct 24
why: Sansec research (OTX pulse, Oct 27) and BleepingComputer report an active supply-chain skimmer on every Convertr checkout since Oct 24. There is no CVE or vendor advisory. Not a Microsoft product and not in KEV.
action: Convertr merchants should remove the third-party analytics script, enforce a CSP that blocks unknown script origins, and warn customers who checked out since Oct 24.
product: Convertr e-commerce platform checkouts (Brazil) loading the tampered analytics script

title: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain DSA-2026-416: unauthenticated root RCE, auth bypass and hard-coded key flaws (CVSS 9.8)
why: Dell advisory DSA-2026-416, with the CVEs published to NVD on Oct 28. Several flaws give an unauthenticated remote attacker root command execution or privileged account creation. No public exploit and no exploitation reported. Not in CISA KEV. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade DD OS to 8.9.0.0, 8.6.1.30, 8.3.1.50 or 7.13.1.90 or later, and restrict Data Domain/DDMC management interfaces to a dedicated management VLAN.

title: Juniper Session Smart Router/Conductor (JSA112183): two unauthenticated CVSS 9.8 flaws - admin takeover of un-onboarded routers and root command injection on Conductor
why: Juniper published bulletin JSA112183 on Oct 28 fixing 18 SSR flaws, including two unauthenticated 9.8s (NVD, SecurityOnline). They are not in CISA KEV. No public exploit or in-the-wild use has been reported yet.
action: Upgrade SSR and Conductor to 7.0.5/7.1.7/7.2.3, onboard staged routers to Mist/Conductor before exposing them, and restrict Conductor's management and salt ports to trusted networks.
product: Session Smart Router and Session Smart Conductor before 7.0.5, 7.1.7, 7.2.3

title: Sophos UTM (end-of-life) unauthenticated root RCE via email-proxy path traversal race; manual patch only
why: Sophos published a pre-auth RCE advisory and CVE on Oct 28 (CNA CVSS4 9.2), and its community blog urges urgent action for UTM Email Protection users. It is not in CISA KEV and no public exploit has been seen.
action: Install Sophos's manual UTM patch now or turn off email-proxy scanning, and plan to migrate off end-of-life UTM.
product: Sophos SG UTM, all versions (up to 9.724) with Email Protection proxy scanning enabled

title: Cisco Finesse unauthenticated SSRF publicly detailed (Horizon3), no fixed release until Jan-Feb 2027
why: Horizon3 published research and a NodeZero test on Oct 27-28, and Cisco says a public announcement exists. There is no fix until 2027 and no workaround. Cisco is not aware of malicious use. Not in CISA KEV. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Restrict the Finesse web interface to trusted networks or VPN, and alert on unexpected outbound requests from Finesse servers to internal services.
product: Cisco Finesse 12.6 and 15.0 (also in Packaged/Unified CCE and Unified CCX); fixes 15.0(1) SU3 Feb 2027, CCE ES Jan 2027, UCCX SU2 Feb 2027
